meta: Tutors use AI to make a personal learning plan for each student: five kids in the same grade, each with different gaps.

muc.title: Same grade, different gaps
muc.text: A tutor teaches five kids in the same grade, each with different gaps. AI helps make a plan for each one.

muc.title: A ten-question test
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to write a ten-question test where each question checks one skill.

muc.title: Eight weeks, basics first
muc.text: Paste the results using only the student's nickname, and ask AI for an eight-week plan that fills in the basics first.

muc.title: A monthly report
muc.text: At the end of the month, ask AI for a short report for parents: where the student improved and what needs more practice.

muc.title: A ten-question diagnostic
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for a ten-question diagnostic test for one student, then check the answer key yourself.
